definition: All deltas are front minus diagonal rear. Flat pose keeps recorded joint angles with root roll/pitch zero. Rotation increment is tilted minus flat geometry; root translation cancels. Lowest cushion vertex is reselected in each orientation.

support_geometry.limitation: Center-line proxy includes cushion rolling. Actual finite contact patches, COP, inertia and dynamic contact force distribution are not solved by this geometric distance.
